title: REPA 自动选 capture 层

standard.summary: 目标模块为空时按模型族自动选单层 mid。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: When the target modules are empty, a single mid layer is chosen automatically by model family.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 目标模块为空时按模型族自动选单层 mid。关且模块空 → fail-closed 不装 hook。

advanced_en.principle: When target modules are empty, automatically picks a single mid layer per model family. Off with empty modules → fail-closed, no hooks installed.
